long_biography.plain_text:
Erich Walter Schwaiger developed his professional foundation in law, practising from Munich in fields that include construction, architecture and condominium property. In the early 1990s, he founded Concept-Real and translated that sector knowledge into an owner-operated residential development business. The group expanded through dedicated project, holding and property-management companies under his direction.

Concept-Real became a substantial Munich housing platform. Its projects include roughly 600 rental homes and 300 owner-occupied apartments within the Am Südpark redevelopment, alongside shops and community facilities. The company has also refinanced residential sub-portfolios to improve costs and release capital for new projects. Schwaiger remains founder, owner and chief executive, with continuing directorships across numerous related entities. That combination makes him an active property operator rather than a passive holder.
